overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs DCT Inflatable Round Spa 4-Person Portable Hot Tub offers a luxurious and convenient way to unwind and rejuvenate at home. Designed with a spacious and ergonomic structure, this premium PVC inflatable spa provides the perfect setting for muscle relaxation and stress relief. Its reduced height ensures easy access, while the included anti-slip mat and manual pump enhance safety and convenience. Ideal for outdoor spaces, this hot tub is delivered curbside, ready to transform your backyard into a personal oasis.
